components.name: Call Button — Start
components.description: Primary action to start a voice session. Pill-shaped, violet gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-call-start { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .7rem 2rem; border-radius: 99px; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6b4efa, #a78bfa); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(107,78,250,.35); transition: filter .18s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-call-start:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-call-start:active { transform: scale(.96); }

components.name: Call Button — End
components.description: Hang-up action. Same pill shape, danger color role.
components.css: .ds-btn-call-end { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .7rem 2rem; border-radius: 99px; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid #fca5a5; background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; box-shadow: none; transition: background .2s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-call-end:hover { background: #fee2e2; } .ds-btn-call-end:active { transform: scale(.96); }

components.name: Agent Card — Rest
components.description: Idle agent card. White surface, quiet border, ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-agent-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e9; border-radius: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 2rem 1rem; aspect-ratio: 9/14; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.04); transition: border-color .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease; } .ds-avatar { width: 90px; height: 90px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ede9fe, #ddd6fe); border: 2px solid #e0d9ff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 2.4rem; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; letter-spacing: -.01em; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-call-start { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .7rem 2rem; border-radius: 99px; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6b4efa, #a78bfa); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(107,78,250,.35); }

components.name: Refresh Button
components.description: Ghost icon button to reload an agent. Subtle at rest, violet on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-refresh { background: none; border: 1px solid #e4e4e9; color: #8e8ea8; border-radius: 7px; width: 26px; height: 26px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; font-size: .9rem; transition: border-color .2s ease, color .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-btn-refresh:hover { border-color: #6b4efa; color: #6b4efa; background: #f0ebff; }

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: Floating session indicator shown when a call is active.
components.html: Sesión activa con Cindy
components.css: .ds-status-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e9; border-radius: 12px; padding: .65rem 1.2rem; font-size: .85rem; color: #1a1a2e; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.06); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-live-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #16a34a; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-pulse 1.4s infinite; flex-shrink: 0; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.3} } .ds-status-bar strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-end-btn { margin-left: auto; background: none; border: 1px solid #fca5a5; color: #dc2626; border-radius: 7px; padding: .22rem .75rem; cursor: pointer; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: inherit; transition: background .2s ease; } .ds-end-btn:hover { background: #fef2f2; }

narrative.overview:
This is a control room, not a landing page. Someone on the Arreglatech team opens it with a specific goal: start a voice session, assess an agent, close the loop. The design serves that intent without friction. Every element either carries state or enables action — nothing decorates for its own sake.

The system lives in a well-lit office environment, on a laptop or a secondary monitor. Light mode is correct here: this is a working tool, not a cinematic experience. The surface is cool-white with a faint gray warmth, the accent is a precise violet-indigo that signals interactivity without performing excitement.

What this system explicitly rejects: the SaaS landing-page convention of gradient cards, purple hero blobs, and 'AI-powered' orb animations that confuse decoration with functionality. No navy-gray corporatism. No sterile minimalism that strips out all personality.
keyCharacteristics: State is always legible: idle / active / locked are visually unambiguous
Accent used sparingly — only on interactive and active elements
Cards earn their existence: three agents, three decision points, no nesting
Typography is single-family (Inter), differentiated through weight and scale
Motion is functional: pulse for live status, orb glow for active session, talking bars for voice activity

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Signal Violet appears on at most 10% of any screen surface. When everything is accented, nothing is.

rules.name: The No-Purple-Surface Rule
rules.body: Violet tint (#f0ebff) is a hover state, not a card or section background. No purple gradients on non-interactive surfaces.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Inter only. No mixing of typefaces. Weight and scale create all hierarchy.

rules.name: The State-as-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows change only when state changes. Hover does not increase elevation on cards. Only an active voice session earns the full shadow treatment.

dos: Do use Signal Violet exclusively for interactive and active-state elements.
Do change elevation (border + shadow) as the state signal for an active session.
Do use uppercase tracked labels only for wayfinding: column headers, the logotype.
Do keep the three-card grid as the only layout structure — no nesting.
Do let motion serve state: pulse, orb glow, talking bars are status communications.
donts: Don't use purple or violet gradients on any non-interactive surface.
Don't introduce navy blue, mid-gray, or enterprise palette colors (corporativo frío).
Don't strip away all personality in the name of cleanliness (minimalismo sin personalidad).
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively — the lock overlay blur is functional.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as an accent stripe.
Don't add gradient text (background-clip: text) on any element.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, margin).
Don't use linear easing for any user-facing transition.
